name: bold
description: Aggressive Baritone settings for faster, less timid movement while avoiding impossible assumptions such as walking on lava without supporting effects or mods.

settings.name: allowSprint
settings.reason: Move at human sprint pace whenever Baritone can path it.

settings.name: sprintAscends
settings.reason: Sprint-jump ascends for faster hill and stair movement.

settings.name: allowParkour
settings.reason: Enable the core risky traversal behavior requested for a bolder bot.

settings.name: allowParkourAscend
settings.reason: Let parkour participate in upward movement when possible.

settings.name: allowParkourPlace
settings.reason: Permit block placement during parkour-style movement.

settings.name: allowDiagonalAscend
settings.reason: Accept faster diagonal upward movement.

settings.name: allowDiagonalDescend
settings.reason: Accept slightly unsafe diagonal descents for speed.

settings.name: allowOvershootDiagonalDescend
settings.reason: Allow sprint-through diagonal descents that may overshoot slightly.

settings.name: overshootTraverse
settings.reason: Treat small overshoots as successful to preserve momentum.

settings.name: allowPlace
settings.reason: Allow bridging, pillaring, and practical route construction.

settings.name: allowBreak
settings.reason: Allow direct routes that require breaking blocks.

settings.name: allowInventory
settings.reason: Allow Baritone to move usable blocks and tools to the hotbar.

settings.name: autoTool
settings.reason: Use the best available tool automatically.

settings.name: allowDownward
settings.reason: Permit digging directly underfoot when the planner chooses that tradeoff.

settings.name: allowWaterBucketFall
settings.reason: Permit bucket-clutch style falls when a water bucket is available.

settings.name: maxFallHeightNoWater
settings.reason: Allow minor fall damage for faster descent, similar to a confident human player.

settings.name: maxFallHeightBucket
settings.reason: Allow near-lethal bucket-fall plans while staying below unarmored lethal fall height.

settings.name: blockPlacementPenalty
settings.reason: Make placed-block routes more competitive.

settings.name: blockBreakAdditionalPenalty
settings.reason: Avoid extra hesitation about breaking blocks.

settings.name: jumpPenalty
settings.reason: Do not penalize jumps in the path cost.

settings.name: avoidance
settings.reason: Do not add conservative mob/spawner avoidance costs by default.

settings.name: mobAvoidanceCoefficient
settings.reason: Neutral mob avoidance; do not irrationally seek mobs.

settings.name: mobSpawnerAvoidanceCoefficient
settings.reason: Neutral spawner avoidance; the planner can choose when risk is worthwhile.

settings.name: avoidUpdatingFallingBlocks
settings.reason: Allow faster mining near sand or gravel instead of forbidding it.

settings.name: pauseMiningForFallingBlocks
settings.reason: Avoid waiting for every falling-block update during aggressive runs.

settings.name: enterPortal
settings.reason: Walk all the way into portals when a portal is the goal.

excluded_settings.name: assumeWalkOnLava
excluded_settings.reason: Requires external abilities such as fire resistance and lava-walking support.

excluded_settings.name: allowVines
excluded_settings.reason: Baritone's docs warn it can trap the bot indefinitely.

excluded_settings.name: assumeSafeWalk
excluded_settings.reason: Requires a separate safe-walk capability and can mis-handle right clicks.
